This assignment will guide you through a practice question from Chapter 3 using the Combined Class NYC Apartments dataset. [Download the dataset](../../data/index.html){target="_blank"} and open it in Jamovi.

For now, as a warm-up for Chapter 3, take notes and submit your answers on Moodle. We will explain many of these concepts in more detail in Chapter 3.

We want to compare the distributions of square footage (`SQFT`) for NYC apartments by `TYPE` (co-ops versus condos). Explain and support your answers with the value of at least one appropriate statistic.

1. Is the distribution of square footage more skewed for condos or co-ops among the apartments in the dataset?



2. Among the apartments in the dataset, which type of apartment *typically* has more square footage?


3. Among the apartments in the dataset, which type of apartment has the more homogeneous distribution of square footage?
